name: Tapping Reeve

relationships.evidence: Dexter: Abner Reeve m. Dec 1743 Deborah Topping or Tapping of Brookhaven; 'While living at Fire Place, in Brookhaven, in 1744, their son Tapping Reeve... was born.'

bioAdditions: Dexter (S1) gives the family: his father Rev. Abner Reeve (b. Southold 21 Feb 1707/8, son of Thomas and Bethia (Horton) Reeve) married Deborah Topping 'or Tapping' of Brookhaven in December 1743, and Tapping was born at Fire Place, Brookhaven, in 1744. That opens a second possible route to John: his grandmother Bethia Horton was surely of Barnabas Horton's Southold family, but which Bethia is not proven (see openQuestionsNew). His mother's place in the Topping family is still untraced.
openQuestionsNew: Which Bethia Horton married Thomas Reeve (b. 1671, d. 1738) as his first wife? The Horton Genealogy (1876) names a Bethia, daughter of Barnabas Horton (son of Caleb) and Sarah Hines of Cutchogue (m. c.1686), who would fit; that would make Tapping a Barnabas Horton descendant (4C8R via Barnabas, if the Rachel Browne -> Horton line holds).
Deborah Topping (d. 1759, aged 42): her father is still unknown.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Two candidate routes (Topping via mother; Horton via grandmother), neither proven.
